function_declarations.name: stripe_sync
function_declarations.description: Reconcile Stripe products + prices from a declared YAML catalog. Idempotent. Defaults to dry-run; apply=true hits the API; prod=true required for live mode; write_env=true merges resolved price IDs into .env.

config.description: Path to the YAML catalog file. Defaults to /opt/aria/config/stripe_products.yaml.

apply.description: Apply changes against Stripe. If false, runs as dry-run and prints the diff.

prod.description: Required when the YAML config sets mode=live. Refuses to hit the live API without this explicit flag.

write_env.description: Merge resolved {env_var: price_id} pairs back into /opt/aria/.env. Requires apply=true.
